search_space: All 81 ordered pairs (y1,y2) in Q[t]^2 where each yi=ai+bi*t and ai,bi are drawn from the fixed ordered set (0,1,-1). The program visits every pair in fixed nested-product order and exactly certifies pairs with y1 constant and y2 nonconstant linear; the first certified witness is (0,t).
witness_description: In the Q-algebra Q[t], with t a formal indeterminate, take m=1, y1=0, and y2=t.
refutation_explanation: The nonzero polynomial X1 in Q[X1,X2] vanishes at (0,t), so the full tuple is algebraically dependent. The algebra generated by y1 over Q is Q[y1]=Q. However, t is not algebraic over Q: for every nonzero p(Z) in Q[Z], p(t) is the same nonzero formal polynomial in Q[t]. Thus the final generator is not algebraic over the algebra generated by the preceding generator.
